messages:
tori: PSA: please do not paste YAML from Google Docs during release week. I have learned this the hard way. :sweat_smile:
samir: story time — we once shipped a hotfix that reverted everything because a tab turned `enabled: true` into a boogeyman. Tabs are like gremlins. :gremlin:
build-bot: build #9001 failed: lint -> yaml: line 12: found tab character that violates indentation
ivy: I propose a celebratory badge for anyone who finds a tab in prod: 'Tab Hunter'. Also maybe a small funeral for semver sanity.
oliver: On semver: I'm lobbying to allow emoji in build metadata. Imagine `v3.2.1+rocket` — it makes pipelines feel alive. :rocket: (also chaos)
tori: The compiler's latest error message was peak 2026: `error: unexpected token: coffee_cup`. I think its started judging my life choices. :coffee:
samir: We should add a pre-commit that replaces tabs and drops party emoji from tags. Automate the grief.
build-bot: FYI: repo rule reminder posted to #devops — convert tabs to 2 spaces; avoid emoji in semver metadata unless approved by release council.
ivy: Vote: stickers or mugs? I vote mugs that say "I beat the YAML"
oliver: Mug wins. Also someone should make a comic: "The day the YAML fought back."
tori: Closing note: backup your editorconfig, pray to the linter, and never trust a paste. :pray:
